mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes electrolyte depletion and hypotension, while perphenazine potentiates orthostatic hypotension and may cause hyponatremia through SIADH; both drugs have anticholinergic and CNS depressant effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure, electrolytes (particularly sodium and potassium), and fluid status; adjust chlorthalidone dose if necessary and counsel patient on orthostatic hypotension precautions.
